title: Mem-Gallery: Benchmarking Multimodal Long-Term Conversational Memory for MLLM Agents
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking long-term memory capabilities (retrieval, reasoning, and knowledge management) in multimodal LLM agents. While it contains a standard ethics statement and a potential risks section regarding data privacy and annotation, these are incidental to the core research and do not constitute an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics.
